definitions.explanation: A chronic metabolic disease characterized by high blood sugar levels due to problems with insulin production or function.

examples.japanese: {糖尿病|とうにょうびょう}の{予防|よぼう}には{食事|しょくじ}と{運動|うんどう}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Diet and exercise are important for preventing diabetes.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{糖尿病|とうにょうびょう}と{診断|しんだん}された。
examples.english: My father was diagnosed with diabetes.

examples.japanese: {糖尿病|とうにょうびょう}の{患者|かんじゃ}は{血糖値|けっとうち}を{管理|かんり}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: Diabetes patients need to manage their blood sugar levels.

notes:
{糖尿病|とうにょうびょう} refers to diabetes mellitus.

Types:
- 1{型|がた}{糖尿病|とうにょうびょう} (Type 1 diabetes)
- 2{型|がた}{糖尿病|とうにょうびょう} (Type 2 diabetes)
- {妊娠|にんしん}{糖尿病|とうにょうびょう} (gestational diabetes)

Related terms:
- {血糖値|けっとうち} (blood sugar level)
- インスリン (insulin)
- {合併症|がっぺいしょう} (complications)
- {低血糖|ていけっとう} (hypoglycemia)

Common expressions:
- {糖尿病|とうにょうびょう}の{治療|ちりょう} (diabetes treatment)
- {糖尿病|とうにょうびょう}{予備軍|よびぐん} (pre-diabetes)

Note:
Diabetes is a major health concern in Japan, with cases increasing due to changing dietary habits. The disease is called {糖尿病|とうにょうびょう} (literally "sugar-urine disease") because one historical symptom was sugar in the urine.
